name: quick-pdf-gen
description: Give it HTML + data, get back a PDF as base64 (or write straight to disk for large files). Supports Handlebars strings, .handlebars files, or native JS template functions, custom Handlebars helpers, dynamic headers/footers, automatic image/font waiting for remote assets, optional Ghostscript compression, and large-PDF-safe output. Reuses one Puppeteer browser instance for speed.
